```yaml
name: Remote Access Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  test-remote-access:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # Test against the new MSRV and stable
        toolchain: ["1.85.0", "stable"]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
          components: clippy, rustfmt
          cache: true
          cache-workspaces: rust/foxglove

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          # Install any system dependencies required for remote access tests
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev pkg-config

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check
        working-directory: rust/foxglove

      - name: Run Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
        working-directory: rust/foxglove

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all-targets --all-features
        working-directory: rust/foxglove

      - name: Run remote access specific tests
        run: |
          # Assuming remote access tests are tagged or in a specific crate
          # Adjust this command based on the actual structure of foxglove-sdk
          cargo test --package foxglove-remote-access --all-features
        working-directory: rust/foxglove
        continue-on-error: true # Fallback if package name differs

      - name: Build examples
        run: cargo build --examples --all-features
        working-directory: rust/foxglove
```
